summary.key_theme: Broadcom 憑藉強勁的 AI 客製化晶片業務與穩健的現金流表現，持續獲得市場與機構投資人青睞，儘管面臨地緣政治與專利訴訟等外部挑戰。

bullish.title: Not Nvidia, Not AMD. Broadcom's Custom Silicon Business Is Quietly Becoming an AI Chip Powerhouse

bullish.title: Cathie Wood Just Dumped $110 Million of AMD--and Bought Nvidia and Broadcom
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Cathie Wood 的 ARK Invest 大舉加碼 Broadcom，顯示專業機構對其長期成長潛力的信心。

bullish.title: History Says Broadcom Stock's Best Season Starts Now. It Has Risen in 13 Straight Fourth Quarters.
bullish.reason: 歷史數據顯示 Broadcom 在過去 13 年的第四季均呈現上漲趨勢，具備強勁的季節性利多支撐。

bullish.title: Broadcom-Toppan JV opens “first” substrate plant in Singapore
bullish.reason: 與 Toppan 的合資廠啟用，強化了高階 FC-BGA 基板的供應能力，有助於滿足 AI 晶片需求。

bullish.title: Broadcom's Dividend Has Grown About 90-Fold Since 2010. Its Next Raise Usually Comes in December.
bullish.reason: 長期穩定的股利成長與強勁的自由現金流，為長期投資人提供價值支撐。

bullish.title: SCHD’s Rules Sold Broadcom in March 2024. The Stock Is Up About 183% Since
bullish.reason: 回顧性分析顯示 Broadcom 的股價表現遠超市場預期，強調了其作為成長型資產的價值。

bullish.title: Broadcom Stock Jumps Nearly 3.2% as $16.7 Billion AI Engine Faces Margin Test
bullish.reason: AI 相關營收成長超過三倍，顯示公司在 AI 基礎設施領域的強大獲利能力。

bullish.title: Broadcom vs. NVIDIA: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Broadcom 擁有 36% 的淨利率與 270 億美元的自由現金流，具備極高的財務穩定性。

bearish.title: INTC, AMD, AVGO: Chip Stocks Lead Slide As Tech Gets Hammered Amid Renewed U.S.-Iran Tensions

bearish.title: Broadcom vs. Qualcomm: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?

bearish.title: Better AI Chip Stock to Buy Today: Broadcom vs. Marvell

bearish.title: Marvell Is Up 210% in 2026: Take Profits, or Buy More?
bearish.reason: 同業 Marvell 的強勁表現對比，可能導致部分資金從 Broadcom 轉移至其他高成長標的。
